name: neorgon-forge
description: Skills for taking on large work and then explaining it: task (scoped execution with delegated workstreams), debrief (the work as a deck), writeup (the work as a published post), voicecheck (copy that stays on-voice across projects), mascot-forge (a generated character, cut out and rigged).

plugins.name: neorgon-forge
plugins.description: Five skills, portable by default. task writes a brief while the work happens; debrief and writeup read it afterwards instead of reconstructing it from memory. voicecheck and mascot-forge cover the two things that drift fastest across a fleet of sites: how the copy reads and how the art holds together.
